group: RT finish: b_alu14_c83 (14B low-nibble-f int/simd ALU) + rt_ray_mem/rt_as_load residual raw
experiment: EXP-M4-13 round-7 encoding field refinement (own-MSL, clean-room, compile-only on local Apple M4; NO GPU dispatch)
summary: Closed ALL residual raw bits on the three targeted RT/int-ALU ops by byte-diffing own-MSL variants and mapping the HW-validated memory/int-ALU family templates onto the byte-identical shapes. (1) b_alu14_c83 was mostly raw (hi/c4/c6/zz/tail = 59 raw bits + 3 byte-slots uncovered): a register-reallocation byte-diff (own-MSL fma-pressure variant) proved byte+7 is a GPR source (it SHIFTS with the reg-pair when the compiler relocates registers) while byte+12/+13 stay FIXED under the same realloc (a separate uniform/traversal-state source operand); byte+4/+6/+10 are fixed format bytes and byte+5/+8/+9/+11 reserved const-0 slots (imad family positions). (2) rt_ray_mem/rt_as_load had 16 raw bits each = the +7/+13 inert padding; retyped to reserved (mod) exactly as the HW-validated device_load reserved7/reserved13, CONST 0x00 across all corpus + own-MSL instances; flags(+6) annotated with the device_load access_desc enum. Result: 0 type=raw bits on all three ops; tokenization byte-identical to baseline over 7474 corpus files; every corpus + own-MSL instance roundtrips asm(disasm(b))==b.
method: Built shdump_r7_rt from tools/shdump/shdump.m (compile-only, never dispatches). Recompiled the corpus producers (s_loopacc, rq_pred, raytracing/*) plus own-MSL variants that add register pressure (a preceding fma / dot chain) to force the compiler to reallocate GPRs around the traversal loop. Extracted AGX via agxparse.py --extract-hex, tokenized with a SCRATCH isadb copy, and byte-diffed. KEY R7 realloc diff: base s_loopacc emits `3f 19 83 18 03 00 80 0e ... c2 8b` (reg-pair r12, byte+7 0x0e=r7, byte+12/13 c2/8b); the fma-pressure variant emits `3f 1d 83 1c 03 00 80 14 ... c2 8b` (reg-pair r14, byte+7 0x14=r10, byte+12/13 UNCHANGED c2/8b) -- so byte+1/+3 and byte+7 are register operands that track allocation, and byte+12/+13 are a separate (uniform/state) operand. Frame/reserved bytes are CONST across all 71 corpus + all own-MSL b_alu14_c83 instances. For rt_ray_mem/rt_as_load, +7/+13 verified const 0x00 across 134/596 corpus + 32/119 own-MSL instances (device_load reserved analogue).

fieldNotes.reg_b: byte+3: SAME register number r as reg_a across all 71 corpus instances (b3 == b1 & 0xfe), bit0=0. The in-place dst/srcA pair. CONFIRMED co-varies with reg_a under realloc.

fieldNotes.srcB_reg: byte+7: GPR SOURCE register (reg<<1, all corpus values even). CONFIRMED (R7 realloc byte-diff): SHIFTS r7->r10 together with the reg-pair when the compiler relocates GPRs -- a fixed frame byte would not move.

fieldNotes.rsv9: byte+9 reserved, CONST 0x00 (imad b9-slot position). Previously UNCOVERED; now explicit.

notes: b_alu14_c83 REGISTER-REALLOC byte-diff (R7, own-MSL, the load-bearing new evidence): base s_loopacc `3f 19 83 18 03 00 80 0e 00 00 03 00 c2 8b` vs an fma-pressure variant `3f 1d 83 1c 03 00 80 14 00 00 03 00 c2 8b`.
